interpretation_boundary: Stage61a prepares only development-train ligands excluded from Pilot-96. It reads no PPARD docking score, fresh-validation row, or locked-test row and launches no docking. Preparation success cannot establish QUBO efficacy, superiority over classical methods, independent validation, quantum execution, speedup, or quantum advantage.
next_gate: independently audit all 144 prepared ligands, then dock only Remaining-144 against all 29 frozen receptors with the three preregistered seeds

preparation.macrocycle_policy: Run Meeko flexible first. If preparation fails or closure pseudoatoms are detected, rerun once with --rigid_macrocycles; require zero closure pseudoatoms in the final PDBQT.
preparation.rdkit_method: ETKDGv3 with explicit hydrogens, useRandomCoords=true, then MMFF94 or UFF with 500 iterations
